For the premiere episode, Sabin CEO Amy Finan speaks with Karen Torghele, a veteran of the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention who authored the first-ever biography of the Sabin Vaccine Institute's namesake, Albert B. Sabin.   Torghele's book, "Albert B. Sabin: The Life of A Polio Vaccine Pioneer," captures the complexities of Sabin's personality and his scientific journey as inventor of the oral polio vaccine.   They discuss why Sabin's life has never been chronicled, and his legacy as a tireless advocate for global access to his disease-preventing vaccine.
